text.en:
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 597 May 29, 1980
AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 592 DATED MAY 3, 1980, CREATING A NATIONAL
COMMITTEE TO TAKE CHARGE OF THE CELEBRATION OF PHILIPPINE INDEPENDENCE DAY
By virtue of the powers vested in me by law, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, do
hereby amend Executive Order No. 592 dated May 3, 1980, by including the Commissioner on Islamic Affairs
as Member of the National Committee to take charge of the celebration of Philippine Independence Day on
This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 29th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty.
